combo-storm: This is Aziza's best category: 31% of games and 23% of series, well above fair share. Token drains and copied spells close games before most combos assemble.
Your losses here are mostly infinite combos: Kinnan with Basalt Monolith and Niv-Mizzet with Curiosity or Tandem Lookout. Hold Swords or Path for Kinnan and Niv-Mizzet.
Aziza is the most-removed card in this pod. Opponents kill her in most games, so recasting her at +2 each time is part of the plan.
Treasure draw spells (Pirate's Pillage, Big Score, Unexpected Windfall) show the biggest lift. Card flow is what keeps the token engine running.
stax-control: Mob Justice is the reason this matchup works: games where you cast it were won 43% of the time versus 17% without. A copied Mob Justice gets past both lifegain and blockers.
Oloro is still the problem deck, winning about 64% of these pods through lifelinkers, Exquisite Blood loops and Test of Endurance.
Aziza gets countered more than once per game here. Bait counters with Impact Tremors or Warleader's Call before casting her.
You face about one board wipe per game (Supreme Verdict, Farewell, Toxic Deluge). Your token spells rebuild faster than most decks recover.
go-wide: This is the weak spot: 15% of games, and you're knocked out first in 56% of them, almost always in combat.
Jetmir causes half your losses. A board of 1/1s can't block a pumped token army, and opponents send their attacks at whoever blocks worst.
Your drains still deal heavy damage here, but the races are lost. Anything that keeps your board alive helps more than more tokens.
Cyclonic Rift and Kindred Dominance wipe your board when they resolve. Hold Clever Concealment for them.
graveyard-big-threats: Light-Paws wins 53% of these pods. Its auras give protection from your colors, so blockers and spot removal stop working. It kills you through combat and commander damage.
Teysa's death-trigger drains punish your tokens when they die in combat or wipes.
You face 1.4 board wipes per game, mostly Winds of Rath, Toxic Deluge and Living Death.
Mob Justice and Purphoros show the biggest lift. Direct damage is the cleanest way past a voltron commander you can't block.
